benchmark_query_examples.prompt: Compare Stripe 2.9%+$0.30 vs Helcim and Stax Interchange-Plus on $65,000/month B2B card volume ($85 avg ticket, 80% online).
benchmark_query_examples.deterministic_result_summary: Stripe costs $26,364/yr (3.38% effective with +0.4% Invoicing Starter [$2 cap] & 10% intl). Helcim IC+ ($0/mo, 0.40%+$0.08 CP / 0.50%+$0.25 CNP) costs $18,642/yr (2.39% effective, saving $7,722/yr). Stax 0% markup ($199/mo tier at $780k/yr + $0.08 CP / $0.15 CNP) costs $17,376/yr (2.23% effective, saving $8,988/yr).

benchmark_query_examples.prompt: What is the 12-month all-in payroll cost for 20 W-2 employees and 3 contractors across 4 US states (FL primary) comparing OnPay vs Gusto vs Rippling?
benchmark_query_examples.deterministic_result_summary: OnPay ($49 base + $6/person, $0 multi-state fee, $0 W-2/1099 year-end fee) costs $2,244/yr ($187/mo). Gusto Simple is single-state only, so Gusto Plus ($80 + $12/person, W-2 and 1099) costs $4,272/yr ($356/mo; prices checked 2026-11-27); Rippling (quote-only, modeled at $85 base + $16/W-2) costs $6,240/yr.

benchmark_query_examples.prompt: How much can a B2B wholesaler save collecting $85,000/month in $2,500 invoices via ACH ($6 cap) vs 2.9% credit cards?
benchmark_query_examples.deterministic_result_summary: Collecting 34 invoices/mo ($85,000/mo) via credit card at 2.9%+$0.30 + 0.4% invoicing costs ~$30,845/yr. Collecting via Helcim B2B ACH (0.50% capped at $6/invoice) costs $204/mo ($2,448/yr)—saving $28,397/yr (92.1% fee reduction).
